main_body: A round leafy bush/canopy blob made of noisy green clusters with a black outline and no trunk or visible front/top split
top_band: none - the column scan shows a random mix of light, mid and dark green runs of 1-3 rows with no distinct lighter horizontal band and no front-edge step
evidence: The whole drawing is a single foliage mass with scattered light and dark green noise. Reading the middle column gives alternating runs of L=155, 94 and 64 with no consistent top surface, front edge line, or separate front face. It does not show a top band over a front face, so the 3/4 contract is not demonstrated. It is not a clear front elevation either, because the shape is organic and there is no flat face. Under the strict rule, the structure is not a visible top surface plus front face, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate uses only 4 distinct colours (a near-black #16161a outline plus three greens at L=64, 94 and 155), against 427 and 567 colours in the references and a median of 4 colours per tile against about 108. The outline is 100% neutral near-black, which is the sticker look, whereas the references use tinted dark tones. The greens are randomly scattered pixel noise, so there are no deliberate leaf clumps, no highlight-to-shadow volume, and no trunk. It is far shallower than the Beodeul trees.
